label: Malmoelab Keyframe Dub After Picture V1
description: daehan-pilot-codex-003을 기준으로 한 말모이랩 교육 포맷. 2D 캐릭터 기준 이미지와 5개 keyframe을 먼저 잠그고, 5개 6초 씬을 순차 생성해 picture lock을 만든 뒤, 더빙과 칠판 타이포를 후반에서 합성한다.

runnerHints.basePrep: Prepare or select a clean 16:9 character base plate with the teacher on the right quarter and an empty board on the left.
runnerHints.keyframeGate: Generate and review five keyframes before any video generation.
runnerHints.pictureStage: Generate five mute 6-second clips with explicit continuous_handoff or transition_cut boundary rules.
runnerHints.dubStage: Lock picture first, then add the six standard voice slots.
runnerHints.typeStage: Apply board typography only after dub lock.

sceneGenerationPolicy.sceneStartRule: each scene declares an approved start frame; continuous_handoff scenes use the prior clip final frame as the next start seed, while transition_cut scenes use their own approved start frame
sceneGenerationPolicy.sceneBoundaryRule: each boundary declares boundaryMode. Use continuous_handoff for uninterrupted classroom gesture continuity. Use transition_cut for intentional time, angle, scale, or beat changes and define transition type, duration, purpose, and audio/visual bridge.
sceneGenerationPolicy.sceneFrameRule: each scene should lock both a start frame and an end frame before motion generation
sceneGenerationPolicy.scenePoseTargetRule: approved keyframes define the target pose and expression for each scene block
sceneGenerationPolicy.defaultCompositionRule: teacher on right quarter, clean chalkboard on left three-quarters

scriptPolicy.defaultOpeningLineRule: reuse the daehan-pilot-codex-003 opening line structure and only swap the character name
scriptPolicy.defaultEndingLineRule: reuse the daehan-pilot-codex-003 ending line unless the brief explicitly overrides it

voiceConfigPolicy.rule: voice-slots may override ttsVoiceEnv, otherwise the renderer resolves the default voice env from the character voice config
